issuer.name: EEA: UAB Monavate (Lithuanian EMI, Bank of Lithuania licence LB002139; programme manager OKX Europe Limited, Malta). Australia: Bano Pty Ltd (ABN 93 643 260 431, AFSL 536984; distributor/processor OKX Australia Pty Ltd). Singapore: not disclosed on the pages read.

funding.supported_assets_note: Spends stablecoins (USDG, USDC, USDT) held in the OKX Pay Wallet; converted to the settlement fiat currency at payment (EEA: EUR; Singapore: SGD domestic / USD international; Australia: USD). A conversion spread of 0–0.10% applies depending on region and stablecoin.

eligibility.usage_note: OKX Learn article (updated 18 Aug 2026): 'available to users across the EU and Norway, excluding Iceland and Liechtenstein' — list expanded by us from 'EU' (27 states) + Norway; no individual country list published. The EEA Regional Addendum (5 Feb 2026) says services are offered to 'EEA residents' and that OKX may exclude jurisdictions at its discretion. Cardholder Agreement: ≥ 18 years old; no residency clause. Virtual card only at the time of the Learn article.

kyc.stages_note: Cardholder Agreement: 'We will not issue the Card or open a Card Account until we have verified your identity.' Addendum: 'completed all applicable identity verification and compliance checks' (OKX account KYC). Documents not itemised on the pages read.

access.note: No subscription tier; cashback varies with the OKX VIP level (trading-volume based), which is not a card tier.

fees.conditions: 'Issuance fee: €0, for the virtual card only.' Physical card fee not stated.
Physical card not offered per the Learn article (virtual only); no delivery fee published.
'Non-EUR FX fee: 0%' on top of Mastercard's exchange rate; EUR transactions 0%.
'Crypto-to-fiat conversion (USDC/G to EUR): 0.1%' spread at spend. Addendum: crypto liquidation fee 'not more than 0.10%'.
ATM withdrawals require a physical card and carry a fee shown only in the app ('a fee applies to each ATM withdrawal'); amount not published; availability varies by region.
Funding of the Pay Wallet from the OKX account not priced on the pages read.

limits.note: 'Card spending limits' exist but amounts are shown only in the OKX account/app; none published on the pages read.

eligibility.usage_note: The Singapore fee article settles domestic spending in SGD and notes 'This information may not apply to all customers'; it does not state who is eligible. No official eligibility page for the Singapore card was read — residency requirement to confirm.

fees.conditions: 'Issuance: S$0, virtual card only.' Physical card fee not stated.

Conversion spread: USDG/USDC→USD 0%; USDT→USD 0.10%; USDG/USDT/USDC→SGD 0.10%. Least favourable value modelled.
Fee shown only in the app; physical card required; regional availability not stated for Singapore.

eligibility.usage_note: Product Disclosure Statement (prepared 9 Jun 2026): 'This PDS and the Card are intended for Australian residents only'; individuals ≥ 18 with an active, verified OKX account and an OKX Pay Wallet; personal use only. Variant currency recorded as USD because 'All Card transactions are settled by Mastercard in US dollars (USD)'.

kyc.stages_note: PDS eligibility: 'satisfy our customer identification, know-your-customer (KYC), and anti-money laundering' requirements, with ID acceptable to the Issuer or OKX. Documents not itemised.

fees.conditions: 'Card issuance: Nil'; replacement nil; refund processing nil (GST inclusive).
PDS: 'The 0.10% conversion spread … is the only fee applied by OKX for this service.'
No OKX FX fee stated; the card settles in USD, so AUD purchases are converted at Mastercard's exchange rate and spread, 'outside OKX's control'.
Not priced in the PDS sections read; the general ATM article says a fee applies, shown in the app.

limits.note: Daily aggregate and per-transaction limits apply but amounts are shown only in the OKX App; contactless AUD 100 without PIN; transactions above AUD 1,000 need in-app verification.

editorial.summary: OKX's stablecoin debit card, offered as separate regional products: a EUR Mastercard for EEA residents (issuer UAB Monavate), a Visa-rate card for Singapore settling in SGD/USD, and a USD-settled Mastercard for Australian residents (issuer Bano Pty Ltd). No issuance, monthly or FX fee is charged by OKX; the only priced cost is a 0–0.10% stablecoin-to-fiat conversion spread. ATM fees and spending limits are shown only in the app. Cashback depends on the OKX VIP trading level and is not published as a rate.
good_for: OKX Pay Wallet users in the EEA, Singapore or Australia who hold USDG/USDC/USDT and want fee-free card spending
Travel spending without a provider FX mark-up (Mastercard/Visa rate applies)
not_for: Anyone who needs a published cashback rate (standard users 'may get none outside promotions')
Residents outside the EEA, Singapore and Australia (South Asia and Africa products exist but were not documented here)
Cash withdrawals: the ATM fee is unpublished and a physical card is required
watch_outs: ATM withdrawal fee and all spending limits are disclosed only inside the OKX app — treated as unknown.
The EEA country list is our expansion of 'EU and Norway, excluding Iceland and Liechtenstein' from a marketing article; the legal Addendum says 'EEA residents' without naming exclusions.
Australian card settles in USD: every AUD purchase goes through Mastercard's exchange rate and spread, which OKX says are outside its control.
Singapore: eligibility, KYC and issuer were not found on the pages read; the fee article warns the information 'may not apply to all customers'.
Cashback is tied to the OKX VIP level (trading volume) and launch promotions; rates, caps and dates are not published on the pages read.
